spans.s:
lagnanirṇaya
(‘deciding a suitable lagna [for initiation into a मन्त्र]’)
------------------------------------------
The zodiac has been divided by the astrologers into twelve rāśis (special signs comprising certain groups of स्तर्स्) like Meṣa (Aries), Vṛṣabha (Taurus) and so on. Every day, the sun (as viewed from the earth) appears to pass through all the twelve Rāśis from Meṣa (Aries) to Mīna (Pisces). The राशि at the time of sun-rise is said to be the ‘lagna’ for that day. This has an important bearing on astrological calculations.
When spiritual aspirants desire to receive a मन्त्र through initiation from a qualified गुरु, different lagnas have been prescribed for different deities. For instance, to receive mantras of विष्णु, the lagnas Vṛṣabha (Taurus), Siṁha (Leo) and धनुस् (Sagittarius) are auspicious.
Similarly Meṣa (Aries), Karkāṭaka (Cancer) and Tulā (Libra) are good for receiving Śivamantras.
And for imparting or receiving शक्ति or the देवी mantras, Mithuna (Gemini), कन्या (Virgo) and Mīna (Pisces) are considered good.
Inauspicious moments can be known by a study of the lagnakuṇḍali (chart based on lagna) and they must be avoided.
